newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Purneftegaz 96 oil output up to 8.48 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russian Purneftegaz 96 oil output up to 8.48 mln T.

text.p: Russia's Purneftegaz produced 8.48 million tonnes (169,600 barrels per day) of crude oil in 1996, up slightly from 8.31 million tonnes (166,200 bpd) in 1995, state-owned holding company Rosneft said on Wednesday.
Rosneft owns 38 percent of shares in AO Rosneft-Purneftegaz.
Rosneft also said output at its unit Sakhalinmorneftegaz in which it also holds a 38 percent stake, slipped last year to 1.49 million tonnes (29,800 bpd) from 1.59 million (31,800 bpd) in 1995.
Purneftegaz reported 1996 pre-tax profit on a Russian accruals basis of 592.02 billion roubles, up from 310.07 billion roubles in 1995.
It said pre-tax profit on a Russian cash basis slipped to 286.23 billion roubles from 310.29 billion in 1995.
Rosneft is the Russian government's agent in all oil production-sharing deals.
